name: No Docker (placeholder)
description: Installs nothing. It exists so `installDocker` can be a real template option: the spec substitutes strings, so the docker-in-docker feature is selected by substituting its *id*, and turning it off needs some id to put there instead.

moby.description: Ignored. Declared only because the options object in devcontainer.json is shared with the docker-in-docker feature this one stands in for, and an undeclared option would be reported as unknown.
